issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 56f 推断，字还挂在线上就结束，摆正环节没渲染
字符各自起跑、后面的字要追越前面的字，曲线低段挤成一团（"GROWTHALL" 叠字），行进中读不出句子
终位按 46px 估宽排版，字距忽宽忽窄；左上角调试标题 "TEXT ON PATH"
曲线是一条 3px 灰线，看不出"增长线"的语义
changes: 补 TEXT_ON_PATH_DURATION = 150f（56f 推进 + 8f 停顿 + 逐字摆正至 ~101f + 静止）
整串字按实测步进沿弧长刚性推进（末字领跑、切线角旋转），行进中即可读出 "GROWTH ALL THE WAY"；曲线 evolve 按弧长比例与车头同步
到达后停 8f，从左到右 1.5f 错峰、12f inOut 摆正到水平基线，终位按实测字宽排版
曲线做成图表增长线：强调色 4px 圆头描边 + 线下渐变面积 + 车头光点 + 网格与刻度；柔光 Backdrop、SF 700
issuesEn: No exported duration: the workbench guessed 56f, so it ended with letters still on the line and the straightening never rendered
Each letter started on its own and later letters had to overtake earlier ones, so the low part of the curve became a pile-up ('GROWTHALL') and the sentence was unreadable in motion
Final layout used a 46px width guess so spacing was uneven; debug label "TEXT ON PATH" top-left
The curve was a 3px grey line with no 'growth chart' meaning
changesEn: Added TEXT_ON_PATH_DURATION = 150f (56f travel, 8f pause, staggered straightening to ~101f, then hold)

The whole string advances rigidly along arc length at measured advances (last letter leading, rotated to the tangent), readable as 'GROWTH ALL THE WAY' while moving; the curve's evolve tracks the lead letter by arc-length fraction
After an 8f pause letters straighten left to right at 1.5f stagger with a 12f inOut onto a horizontal baseline laid out from measured widths
The curve is now a growth chart: 4px accent round-cap stroke, gradient area fill, lead-point dot, gridlines and ticks; soft-light Backdrop, SF 700
